_comment: Labels for issue triage (ADR-0003). The triage workflow creates any that are missing; it never edits or deletes an existing label (build-order, no-code, spike, human-run stay as they are). Descriptions stay within GitHub's 100-character limit. Owners map an area to the GitHub login assigned when an issue has no assignee; "*" is the fallback.

sev:critical.description: Wrong or duplicated booking, corrupted book, reconciled flag set, float money, data leak

sev:major.description: Safety check off or bypassable, crash, data dropped without a report, core flow broken

sev:minor.description: Wrong behaviour with a workaround, or a visible degradation (ADR-0003)

sev:trivial.description: Cosmetic, wording, docs, or a test-only gap (ADR-0003)

reach:common.description: Normal use with an ordinary book, statement and configuration triggers it (ADR-0003)

reach:edge.description: Needs an unusual book, statement, backend, configuration or timing (ADR-0003)

reach:adversarial.description: Only when someone sets it up: crafted memo, statement or document, hostile rule pack

area:classifier.description: Classifier tiers: rules, kNN and the LLM tail (architecture 5.2)

area:model-adapter.description: Model adapter: redaction boundary and backends (architecture 5.2)

area:documents.description: paperless-ngx documents and the bill matcher (proposal 0002)

area:review.description: Disposition, batch gate and the review file (architecture 5.2)

area:contracts.description: JSON contracts between the pipeline and the book process (architecture 5.1)

area:book.description: Book process: session, exporter, applier, read-back, assertions, undo (5.3)

area:launcher.description: Launcher: backup, export, review, apply, open GnuCash (architecture 5.4)

area:testenv.description: The throwaway test environment and its synthetic data (testenv/)

area:ci.description: CI, the gate, workflows and repository tooling

priority:P0.description: Drop other work, fix now, block the release (ADR-0003)

priority:P2.description: Next milestone, or whenever it fits (ADR-0003)

needs-triage.description: Severity or reach could not be placed; see the triage comment (ADR-0003)
